message: Astra: In your latest notebook draft, do the instructions to record temperature and humidity give the reader an observation, or still promise one? Which part deserves your attention now: deciding what this page is for, or discovering that through a writing attempt? What would further thinking resolve that an attempt would not, and what unresolved uncertainty makes drafting premature? Within this same scene, what evidence would distinguish a useful next version from another rearrangement of the outline? Could you choose and carry out your next step on that basis?
speaker: Astra
